LanguageData.Relics40k.GeneCryptCatalyst.Confirm:
{PAWN_nameDef} will be remade as a Thunderborn Astartes.

The proto-ossmodula, musculeator and furybound sequences will be stripped out and replaced with the full Astartes gene-line. The mental scarring the furybound has already caused is permanent and will not heal.

{PAWN_pronoun} will be comatose for 10 days and will need to be fed.

The catalyst is consumed. There is no way back.
LanguageData.Relics40k.GeneCryptCatalyst.LetterText: The gene-crypt catalyst has taken hold. {PAWN_nameDef}'s failing proto-organs are being rewritten into their perfected Astartes forms, and the furybound sequence is burning out of {PAWN_possessive} brainstem.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} will lie comatose for the next 10 days and must be fed. What wakes up will no longer be dying by design - though what the fury carved into {PAWN_objective} stays carved.
LanguageData.Relics40k.BloodChalice.NotHemogenic: blood does not run red enough
LanguageData.Relics40k.BloodChalice.Ready: Full. Ready to be drunk from.
LanguageData.Relics40k.BloodChalice.Confirm:
{PAWN_nameDef} will drain the chalice.

Every wound, scar, sickness and addiction will be burned out of {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_possessive} hemogen and deathrest will be filled to the brim. Lost limbs will not return.

The chalice will take 15 days to refill.
LanguageData.Relics40k.BloodChalice.Message: {PAWN_nameDef} drains the blood chalice. The wounds close as {PAWN_pronoun} drinks.
